questions.en: By what German name is the Romanian region of Transylvania also known?

timeline.labelEn: The German name 'Siebenbürgen' for Transylvania is first recorded in writing
timeline.labelDe: Der deutsche Name „Siebenbürgen“ für Transsilvanien ist erstmals schriftlich belegt

questions.notes: The card's statement is false: Transsilvanien and Siebenbürgen are two names for the same region. The name is first attested 'Ende des 13. Jahrhunderts', hence an approximate decade.
